Factsheet hoofdwinkelstructuur Den Haag 2017: Station Den Haag Hollands Spoor (stadsdeel Centrum). Deze factsheet bevat gegevens over het winkelcentrum, zoals aantallen winkels, winkelvloeroppervlak, omzet en huurprijzen. De PDF's van de verschillende winkelcentra zijn gekoppeld aan polygonen hoofdwinkelstructuur Via dataset: Via kaartviewer: PDF's afkomstig uit Retailmonitor Den Haag, vastgesteld op 20-02-2019 (RIS30527). Coverage: The Hague. The portal files it under Economy. The portal shows 2026-03-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-den-haag-opendata-portal.
